statements.text: America must lead the world in artificial intelligence — not China. To win that race, we need to cut the burdensome regulations that slow innovation and unleash pro-energy policies that power our economy and our tech sector.

statements.quoted: The Trump administration is committed to WINNING the AI race for the American people. President Trump has unveiled a commonsense national policy framework in order to achieve this goal while keeping Americans safe. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/J1ovH8r8nM
